source_batch.unit_label: BRBL::MOD_C::U17: Handle inspection orders, completeness certificates and costs

payload.title: An inspection order has scope, time and a response route
payload.core_explanation_md:
The court can permit inspection and copying or require the bank to produce the specified certified entries. The further completeness certificate concerns other entries relevant to the matters in issue; staff must search the proper record scope before signing it. The source describes three clear days excluding bank holidays unless the authority directs otherwise.

Before the compliance time, the bank may use the stated offer-to-produce or show-cause route; an intention to object is not permission to silently ignore the process. Costs are in the court discretion, including the described bank fault or improper-delay circumstances, and the cost order has its own enforcement effect.

self_check.prompt_text: Can a completeness certificate be signed without checking for other relevant entries?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. The certificate must match the actual record search and scope.

payload.stem_md: A team signs that no other relevant entries exist without searching the relevant period or backup record. What is the defect?

options.explanation_md: The substantive completeness assertion lacks support.

options.text_md: The certificate exceeds what the team has established
options.explanation_md: Certification must reflect the actual relevant-record examination.

options.text_md: The customer automatically waives all evidence rights
options.explanation_md: No waiver follows from an unsupported certificate.

options.text_md: The inspection order itself proves the database is complete
options.explanation_md: The order requests evidence; it does not certify it.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Certification must reflect the actual relevant-record examination.

payload.stem_md: A bank intends to show cause against an order and simply takes no action before the stated deadline. Which distinction matters?

options.text_md: Intention alone is a granted exemption
options.explanation_md: An internal intention is not procedural relief.

options.text_md: Every inspection order is void if inconvenient
All costs must automatically be charged to the customer
options.explanation_md: Cost allocation is a legal decision.

options.text_md: Use the prescribed timely response route and track any further order
options.explanation_md: The actual procedure and authority decision govern compliance.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The actual procedure and authority decision govern compliance.
